systems.name: PocketPaw
systems.description: Self-hosted agentic OS: agents live, decide, and remember on the customer's own infrastructure. OSS runtime (src/pocketpaw) plus the multi-tenant enterprise cloud tier (ee/pocketpaw_ee).

containers.name: PocketPaw Runtime + Cloud
containers.description: The Python application: the OSS agent runtime and the enterprise cloud tier (FastAPI). Components below are the major logical subsystems.

components.name: Runtime
components.description: Agent core: 8 pluggable LLM backends, 11 channel adapters, the message bus, the tool registry with trust-level policy, and bundled-skills auto-install. src/pocketpaw/{agents,bus,tools,runtime}.

components.name: Fabric (ontology)
components.description: Typed-object + typed-link ontology with provenance and multi-hop (<=5) queries. Two SQLite stores: live objects/links (async) and the type registry (sync). src/pocketpaw/fabric + ee/pocketpaw_ee/fabric.

components.name: Instinct (governance gate)
components.description: Propose -> approve/reject -> meter governance with a tamper-evident audit ledger and Decision-Graph events. Gates pocket writes, code changes, connectors, and mandates. src/pocketpaw/instinct + ee/pocketpaw_ee/instinct + ee/cloud/pockets/instinct_*.

components.name: Connectors
components.description: Workspace-scoped typed data integrations (Gmail/Stripe/Postgres/...). CLOUD vs LOCAL execution; derives per-pocket surface profiles. src/pocketpaw/connectors + ee/cloud/connectors.

components.name: Discovery (Sovereign Zero-Setup)
components.description: On-box digesters turn connector exhaust and Instinct corrections into Fabric objects and governed rules, proposed for human review. Pure/deterministic, no off-box calls. ee/pocketpaw_ee/discovery. NOTE: currently branch-only (feat/szd-*), not yet merged to dev.

components.name: Cloud Chat + Surface engine
components.description: Cloud agent orchestration: resolves the chat surface (home/pockets/sites/code/studio/belt), injects per-surface preambles, and assembles scope/pocket/participant context. ee/cloud/chat (agent_service) + ee/cloud/surface.

components.name: Pockets + rippleSpec
components.description: Pocket workspace containers (agents+data+tools+KB+rules). The rippleSpec merge endpoint; data sources (read GETs) and write actions gated through Instinct. ee/cloud/pockets.

components.name: Paw Sites
components.description: Publish pockets as edge sites. Two engines x two modes: {ripple,svelte} x {static,dynamic}; dynamic = per-tenant Cloudflare D1. ee/pocketpaw_ee/sites + the paw-sites generator.

components.name: Foresight
components.description: Scenario simulation / rehearsal: soul-seeded personas run per-tick cognition loops with calibration and backtest gating. ee/pocketpaw_ee/foresight.

components.name: Enterprise Ops
components.description: Fleet install, Calendar (external sync + conflict detection), Guards (RBAC/ABAC), Audit (placeholder), and the Paw Bar customer decision loop. ee/pocketpaw_ee/{fleet,calendar,guards,audit,paw_bar}.

containers.name: MongoDB
containers.description: Primary cloud datastore: pockets, sessions, messages, agents, sites, Instinct approvals, connectors.

containers.name: Redis / Dragonfly
containers.description: Resumable chat-run streams (SSE transport) and source-refresh rate budgets.

containers.name: Qdrant
containers.description: Vector store for embeddings and semantic retrieval.

containers.name: Ollama
containers.description: Local LLM inference for self-hosted / sovereign deployments.

systems.name: Soul Protocol
systems.description: External: portable identity + 5-tier memory (.soul). PocketPaw runtime, Fabric, and Instinct write to the soul journal (Decision Graph).

systems.name: Ripple
systems.description: External: Svelte 5 generative-UI runtime that renders rippleSpec into live UI. Pockets and the static/ripple site track compile through it.

systems.name: Cloudflare Workers + D1
systems.description: External: edge deploy target for Paw Sites; per-tenant D1 backs dynamic sites.

systems.name: kb-go
systems.description: External: on-box knowledge-base compiler. Discovery uses its keyless convo-ingest path to compile unstructured exhaust without any off-box call.
